The '''Feast of Prosperity''' was an event organized by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during a [[Third Galactic War|galactic conflict]], between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Feast of Prosperity was a lavish banquet organized by two rising [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Gaboorga]] and [[Duuba]], during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Hutts organized the feast to mend the declining reputation of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and aimed at advancing their own business interests by masquerading as a charitable event for the galaxy's poor.<ref name="TORWEB" />

Although the Feast could return the Cartel to its previous glory, Gaboorga and Duuba undermined each other's efforts due to conflicting interests, requesting the aid of third parties to help them in their goals.<ref name="TORWEB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Feast of Prosperity is an annual event introduced in the update 6.1.4 to the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORWEB" />
